Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in High Point for 2026, and here is what he found: 10 family events, at least 2 of them free. The new listings run from November 27 (Winter Glow at the Point) through December 26 (the High Point University Community Christmas Drive), with the High Point Holiday Stroll (December 5), Winter WonderPark (December 5 to 19) and A Christmas Carol The Musical (December 11 to 13) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in High Point

  • 10 Christmas events for kids in High Point (5 already live plus 5 new)
  • At least 2 free events, including Winter WonderPark and the High Point University Community Christmas Drive
  • Meet Santa: Winter Glow at the Point (Fridays and December 18 and 19) and the High Point Holiday Stroll (December 5)
  • Trains: Winter Glow at the Point and Winter WonderPark's Polar Express train
  • Shows: A Christmas Carol The Musical at High Point Theatre (December 11 to 13)
  • New listings run from November 27 to December 26

Planning a bigger day out? High Point families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Greensboro, which covers Winter Wonderlights, the Festival of Lights, ice skating at Winterfest, the Nutcracker ballet and Santa visits.
